name: Anime Card Frame
author: d02d02
description: A Duel-Links-style full-bleed card presentation: the frame, title plate and separate ATK/DEF plaque are replaced by one unified frame, the card art is enlarged to fill it, and ATK/DEF, level stars and the attribute icon move into a band under the art.

settings.label: Full-bleed layout
settings.description: Hides the small retail frame and title plate, enlarges the card art, and moves ATK/DEF, level stars and the attribute icon into a bottom band. Off: the card viewer and every other big-card screen look exactly like retail.
